Safer gambling at Vantro

Set a deposit limit, take a time-out or exclude yourself with BetStop. Free, confidential help: 1800 858 858.

On this page

  1. Deposit limits
  2. Time-outs
  3. BetStop self-exclusion
  4. Getting help

Deposit limits

Choose a daily, weekly or monthly limit under Account → Limits. Lower limits apply straight away. Increases wait seven days.

Time-outs

Take a break from 24 hours to six months. You cannot log in or bet until the time-out ends, and it cannot be reversed early.

BetStop self-exclusion

BetStop is the National Self-Exclusion Register. Registering excludes you from every licensed Australian online wagering provider for three months to life. Register at betstop.gov.au.

Getting help

Gambling Help Online offers free, confidential support 24/7: call 1800 858 858 or visit gamblinghelponline.org.au.

If gambling stops being fun, stop. Help is free and confidential.

Questions before you join

Can I cancel a time-out early?

No. A time-out stays in place until the end date you chose.

Does BetStop cover all betting sites?

It covers every licensed Australian online and phone wagering provider.

Will Vantro contact me during a time-out?

No. Marketing stops while a time-out or self-exclusion is active.

Is the help line really free?

Yes. Gambling Help Online is free, confidential and open 24/7.
